_why: M1 lab success end-state. Object state only: no Pod phase alone and no performance number. Every kubectl sets KUBECONFIG and the context itself. Paths are relative to the learner tree (the labs repo root); in src run it from labs/ with: (cd labs && node ../scripts/run-checks.mjs m1/checks.json).

checks.describe: namespace m1-baseline exists and is Active
checks.run: printf 'ns=%s\n' "$(KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core get ns m1-baseline -o jsonpath='{.status.phase}')"

checks.describe: Pod device-request's PodScheduled condition reads status=False reason=Unschedulable, read from .status.conditions and not from .status.phase
checks.run: KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m1-baseline get pod device-request -o jsonpath='status={.status.conditions[?(@.type=="PodScheduled")].status} reason={.status.conditions[?(@.type=="PodScheduled")].reason}'; echo

checks.describe: the PodScheduled message names the missing extended resource
checks.run: KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m1-baseline get pod device-request -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions[?(@.type=="PodScheduled")].message}'; echo

checks.describe: Deployment sim's container sim carries no readinessProbe
checks.run: sh -c 'set -e; n=$(KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m1-baseline get deploy sim -o jsonpath="{.spec.template.spec.containers[?(@.name==\"sim\")].name}"); p=$(KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m1-baseline get deploy sim -o jsonpath="{.spec.template.spec.containers[?(@.name==\"sim\")].readinessProbe}"); if [ -z "$p" ]; then echo "container=$n readinessProbe=none"; else echo "container=$n readinessProbe=set"; fi'

checks.describe: volume simulator's image.reference equals the pinned simulator digest
checks.run: KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m1-baseline get deploy sim -o jsonpath='{.spec.template.spec.volumes[?(@.name=="simulator")].image.reference}'; echo

checks.describe: the sim Pod's log carries both startup-state=loading and startup-state=serving
checks.run: sh -c 'l=$(KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m1-baseline logs deploy/sim -c sim); a=$(printf "%s\n" "$l" | grep -c "^startup-state=loading"); b=$(printf "%s\n" "$l" | grep -c "^startup-state=serving"); echo "loading=$a serving=$b"'

checks.describe: the EndpointSlice for Service sim lists at least one endpoint with ready=true
checks.run: sh -c 'n=$(KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m1-baseline get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=sim -o jsonpath="{.items[*].endpoints[*].conditions.ready}" | tr " " "\n" | grep -c true); echo "ready_endpoints=$n"'

printf 'Available=%s\n' "$(KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core get apiservice v1beta1.metrics.k8s.io -o jsonpath='{.status.conditions[?(@.type=="Available")].status}')"

checks.describe: HPA sim has one Resource metric cpu at averageUtilization 50 and status.currentMetrics holds a number
checks.run: KUBECONFIG="${KUBECONFIG:-/tmp/grid-core.kubeconfig}" kubectl --context kind-grid-core -n m1-baseline get hpa sim -o jsonpath='{.spec.metrics[*].type} {.spec.metrics[0].resource.name} {.spec.metrics[0].resource.target.averageUtilization} {.status.currentMetrics[0].resource.current.averageUtilization}'; echo

checks.describe: the simulator's queue-depth metric is readable through the API server's service proxy
baseline-failures.md holds the three fixed headings in order

assert.matches: ^## A device request no node can satisfy\|## A slow-starting server behind a Service with no readiness gate\|## An autoscaler watching CPU while the queue grows\|$

checks.describe: each wrapper exists and, with comment lines stripped, execs clusters/grid-core/<same-name>.sh
checks.run: sh -c 'for n in create verify teardown; do f=grid-platform/clusters/grid-core/$n.sh; if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -v "^[[:space:]]*#" "$f" | grep -q "exec bash .*clusters/grid-core/$n\.sh"; then printf "$n=exec "; else printf "$n=missing "; fi; done; echo'

checks.describe: PROFILE.md records SIZE, a sha256 node-image digest and the verify.sh OK line
checks.run: sh -c 'f=grid-platform/clusters/grid-core/PROFILE.md; a=$(grep -cE "^SIZE=[0-9]+$" "$f"); b=$(grep -cE "sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}" "$f"); c=$(grep -c "^OK: grid-core verified" "$f"); echo "size=$a digest=$b ok=$c"'
